name: NANNA
detailed_description:
About the Game

NANNA's plants are procedural and grow in real time. No need to farm your plants in quantity, but to create and produce the specific plant breeds of your desire. As you garden, you will acquire fame, money, and friends' admiration. However, you are not the only one who is growing their desires. Talk to your friends and face the complex web of stories from the multiple characters struggling to garden what perhaps they should not…

In order to create the ultimate plant, what sacrifices will you have to make?

Story

Roots in gloom, in a quiet room. Green things bloom and spell out doom.

Recently, Anna returned to her hometown to attend her grandmother's reburial. After moving into Nana’s apartment, she realizes that she can finally focus on her true passion – the yearning to create a plant that will mesmerize the world.

While Anna gardens in her room, her hometown friends find comfort in talking with her. She hears eerie stories about the Mafia, a Chef, a Private Investigator, a Bodyguard, a Cop, and many more. Anna eventually realizes that she is not the only one who has been gardening desires.

Features

In NANNA, you will manage your time to create your best plant breed.

You will do the following activities :

  • Grow various plants while maximizing their stats and appearances. Plants in NANNA grow in real time and have randomized stats based on the values inherited from their parent plant. Pick out and plant the seed with the desired stat to fit your needs.  

  • Register and submit your plants to the contests with various themes. There are contests for you to participate in, each with its own deadlines that reward you with hefty prizes and fame. Each will have an interesting theme like "Produce the Spiciest Fruit with Tons of Protein"; it will be important to increase your know-how to make your creation shine.

  • Buy interiors / Decorate your room. It will be crucial to organize your room with efficiency in mind. As your room space is finite, you will have to place the furniture and items in a way that is mindful of your plant breeding pipeline. Meanwhile, making them look cute wouldn't hurt either.

  • Hang out with your hometown friends and talk about their lives. Since you recently moved back to your hometown, you have some catching up to do with your friends. Spending time with them will give you the unique benefits of leveling up your character stats or gaining important information about helpful events. However, soon you will realize that not everything is smooth sailing for them.

  • Help your friends out with your plants. As the story proceeds, your friends will start asking you various favors, utilizing your talent in plant breeding. Giving them what they need will greatly improve your relationships with them, granting you even more benefits.

  • Work out, sing, study... live your life and level up your stats. You can also increase your mental and physical character stats on your own. Engaging in various activities will improve Anna in many aspects of gameplay, making gardening more efficient.

short_description: NANNA is a cozy indoor farming and life simulator where you create your own plant breeds. Decorate your room with efficiency in mind, while thrilling stories of various characters unfold around you. Groom your little garden… but can you handle what you will unearth in the end?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later versions
  • Processor: 2GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 mb video memory, shader model 3.0+
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
